# Life Starter Kit

> Practical starter kits for parts of everyday life: what to buy, in what order, what it costs, and what tends to go wrong. Each module has an ai-context.md written to be pasted into an AI assistant. Not professional advice; see DISCLAIMER.md.

## Modules

- [Home](home/ai-context.md): choosing products and services that improve a home without overspending (fragrance-free soap dispensers, hot tub upkeep). Status: Draft.
- [Supplements](supplements/ai-context.md): how to evaluate a supplement (need, evidence, quality seals, label auditing, interactions). Recommends no doses, timings or combinations. Status: Draft.
- [Drone](hobbies/drone/ai-context.md): getting into FPV flying with a tiny whoop: buying order, analog vs digital, US recreational rules. Status: Draft.

Each module also has a SKILL.md for loading it into Claude as a skill; it points to the module's files and adds no new facts: [Home](home/SKILL.md), [Supplements](supplements/SKILL.md), [Drone](hobbies/drone/SKILL.md).

## Planned (scope only, no ai-context yet)

- [Hobbies](hobbies/README.md): motorsports, snowboarding, skateboarding, photography, fishing and boating.
- [Growing](growing/README.md): beginner houseplants, with a cannabis Booster Pack for California adults 21 and over.

## Repository

- [README.md](README.md): overview and module list
- [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md): not medical, legal or financial advice
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): module template, content rules, starter kits and Booster Packs
